title: Penumbra Ring - Wedge by Wedge
_note: Barrier mood sibling / late-receding state - same place after several constellations relit, fog receded, hope bled into the drone. The evolving-state pair to A: same DNA, audibly thawing. gbc 4-voice band. 64 BPM (deliberately slow, below gbc 80 floor - accept the intentional slow-tempo warning), 4/4, D minor brightening toward F major. 24 bars. Vesper motif EMERGES for the first time - the rising hopeful leap (D3->G3->A3) surfaces out of the pad, incomplete but reaching, foreshadowing its full triumphant return at the Spire. lead=the lonely note grown into hopeful tentative ascending bell-tipped phrases creeping over the drone. harmony=fog-pad lightens, detune resolving, warm intervals opening up. bass=drone lifts into slow hopeful root movement. drums=heartbeat strengthens and steadies, a soft hat joining. Last bar C(V of F) -> warm pull back into the now-thawing top.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Lonely note grows into hopeful tentative phrases. The Vesper rising leap D3->G3->A3 reaches up but the settle stays incomplete - reaching, not landing. Brightens toward F by the end.
